bio: Research Overview Research Background Publications Contact Us Dr. Langer is focused on clinical research addressing surgical access and outcomes for pediatric surgical patients in low-resource settings throughout the world. In particular she is interested in clinical research to improve diagnostic and treatment capacity for congenital and acquired surgical problems in Tanzania and Uganda. She has a particular interest in treatment of abdominal wall defects in a low-resource setting, and pediatric surgical oncology access and care in Africa. Dr. Langer studied medicine at the University of Saskatchewan and trained in general surgery and pediatric surgery at the University of British Columbia. She pursued a research fellowship at Boston Children's Hospital during her residency and then obtained a Masters in Public Health in Developing Countries from the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine.
